testCases.title: Valid Search Keyword
preconditions: User is logged into the application.
steps: Navigate to the product search page.
Enter a valid search keyword in the search bar.
expectedResults: The page displays a list of products matching the search keyword.

testCases.title: Invalid Search Keyword
preconditions: User is logged into the application.
steps: Navigate to the product search page.
Enter a search keyword that does not match any products.
expectedResults: The page displays an empty result message indicating no matching products were found.
